capabilities: Organize materials into projects and actions
Transcribe audio, OCR documents and describe images with AI
Draft action, student, project and term reports
extras: Chinese user guide and PDF operation manual are hosted separately; organization mode needs a self-hosted Fastify/PostgreSQL backend kept on a separate branch; no telemetry and no automatic plugin updates.
problem: Teachers in project-based learning have no structured way inside Obsidian to gather classroom evidence and turn it into per-student, project and term assessment reports.

relations.evidence: the plugin contacts the DeepSeek/GetNote endpoints configured by the teacher

summary: Local-first workbench that collects classroom materials per project and action, uses AI to extract evidence, and drafts linked assessment reports.
